title: Generative
description:
An exercise in MIDI manipulation. A single MIDI source routes messages to multiple tracks, each with cascaded arpeggiators running at different note lengths and extensions. The result is one input, a single chord, triggering a whole hierarchy of devices at different intervals, lengths, and voicings. On top of the structure, two hooks were created with automation applied to shape the sound over time, intended to mimic a sound design installation where sensors modify parameters in real time. 

The project ended up in dark ambient territory, so I leaned into that. Dissociation was introduced by layering in noise that gradually drowns out the original tracks. Anxiety came through by increasing delay repetitions on the active MIDI parts while shifting stereo panning to send accelerating elements bouncing around the listener.

videos.label: Generative Ableton Project
videos.caption: A look at the Ableton session. The timeline shows only one MIDI chord sustained throughout the entire playback. The individual instruments reveal how the arpeggiators handle all the MIDI manipulation, and the automation lanes show how the parameters shift to mimic incoming sensor data.
